description: Answers "is there a magnetic storm now / today?", "what is the Kp index?", "how is space weather?". The current planetary K index (Kp) and NOAA G-scale storm level, when it was observed and whether it is still current, the next storm in the NOAA 3-day forecast, and a one-sentence summary. Data from NOAA SWPC and GFZ Potsdam. Geophysical data only; no health information.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the person asking, such as Europe/Moscow or America/New_York. Local times and days use it. Defaults to UTC.

name: get_geomagnetic_now

forecastIssuedAt.description: When NOAA issued the 3-day forecast used, UTC.

generatedAt.description: When this answer was produced, UTC.

peak.description: NOAA G-scale level. Kp is graded by the whole number it rounds to, so 4.67 is already G1.

nextStorm.description: The next storm in the NOAA 3-day forecast that has not ended; null if none.

asOf.description: When the value is no longer current: the local time it was observed, the date as well if not today.

gScale.description: NOAA G-scale 1 to 5 during a storm; null below a storm.

isCurrent.description: True while the value still describes the present: 90 minutes for the NOAA estimate, 6 hours for the GFZ index.

kp.description: Planetary K index, 0 to 9 in thirds, as published.

kpText.description: Kp as the Geomagnetic Storms X apps write it: one decimal.

level.description: NOAA G-scale level. Kp is graded by the whole number it rounds to, so 4.67 is already G1.

levelName.description: The level in words, such as "G1, minor storm".

observedAt.description: Start of the interval the value describes, UTC.

observedAtLocal.description: The same moment in the requested time zone, ISO 8601 with offset.

source.description: noaa: the NOAA SWPC estimate, updated every minute; gfz: the GFZ Potsdam three-hourly index.

reading.description: The newest Kp value; null if none has been received yet.

sources.description: Where the data comes from and on what terms.

stale.description: True when the data service was unreachable and this is the last copy received.

summary.description: The forecast in one sentence, as the Geomagnetic Storms X apps say it.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone every local time here is in.

title: Geomagnetic conditions now
